svg.title: An organisation in layers
svg.desc: Five planes pulled apart and staggered, each with a small scene. At the top, social infrastructure, people in two groups joined by dotted lines across them. Then operational infrastructure, modules laid out in a grid, a few of them built on. Then governance, a route crossing the plane through gates, one of them open. Then culture, a long-standing building with people of different generations on slow strata. At the base, the place of work, desks and people where these arrangements meet.

g.text: built by trying to make something
the work runs on, ready for the next
that shape what people feel able to
change. The slowest ground of all
and somewhere tangible to look for

svg.text: Adapted from the author's thesis, after Pagh & Cook (2023).
